how_page.title: How continuity actually moves
how_page.subtitle: The Continuity Concierge is not a chatbot. It is a longitudinal surface that carries your threads, your in-flight decisions, and the open loops you said you would come back to.
how_page.meta_description: How the LanOnasis Continuity Concierge carries decisions, threads, and momentum across sessions, projects, and tools.
how_page.principles_subtitle: Four shifts that distinguish a continuity surface from a memory surface.

continuity_over_retrieval.title: Continuity, not retrieval
continuity_over_retrieval.body: The Concierge surfaces the thread that matches your intent, not the record that matches your query.

reflection_over_storage.title: Reflection, not storage
reflection_over_storage.body: A thread is held with its surrounding context, so it still feels live when you return next month.

identity_over_time.title: Identity over time
identity_over_time.body: Continuity accumulates as a working relationship between you and the Concierge, not as a folder of snapshots.

briefing_over_query.title: Briefing, not query
briefing_over_query.body: Open the dashboard and the Concierge briefs you on what matters next, instead of waiting to be asked.

capture.title: 1. Capture a thread
capture.body: Save a moment, a decision, or a half-formed idea. The Concierge treats it as a thread — not a record — so the surrounding context stays alive.

reflect.title: 2. Reflect across time
reflect.body: When you come back, the Concierge reconnects the thread to what you have been doing since — meetings, PRs, half-finished docs — without you having to re-explain.

synthesize.title: 3. Synthesize the briefing
synthesize.body: At the start of each session, the Concierge hands you a briefing: the open threads, the decisions still in flight, and the next defensible step in each.

brief.title: 4. One durable next step
brief.body: Continuity is built one decision at a time. The Concierge prefers one move you can defend six months from now over ten flashy suggestions.

how_page.closing_body: Read the /why page for the case against storage-as-a-service and for continuity-as-a-relationship.

why_page.title: Why continuity, not memory
why_page.subtitle: Memory is what you stored. Continuity is what you are still doing. The difference matters more than the model you use to query it.
why_page.meta_description: Why LanOnasis is built around continuity rather than memory, and why a longitudinal thinking partner beats a smarter chatbot for real work.
why_page.problem_title: The problem with a smarter chatbot
why_page.problem_body: A memory surface optimises for recall. A continuity surface optimises for the next defensible step in work that is already in motion. Most of what you actually need help with is the second one — and it is the one storage-shaped products have never been incentivised to solve.
why_page.pillars_subtitle: What changes when the product is built around continuity rather than around storage.

continuity.title: Continuity
continuity.body: We optimise for the next defensible step, not for the next-best answer to a question you already know how to ask.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Threads are held with their context, so a thread you started last month still feels alive — not archived, not summarised away.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body: Continuity accumulates as a working relationship between you and the Concierge. The Concierge gets better at your work the longer it carries it.

briefing.title: Briefing
briefing.body: The Concierge briefs you on what matters next, instead of waiting to be queried. The dashboard opens with what you owe yourself, not with an empty search box.

query_to_briefing.to: Brief you on what matters next

why_page.trust_body: The Continuity Concierge is a chief of staff, not an autopilot. The framing of continuity keeps you as the decision-maker and gives you a partner who has been paying attention for years. The framing of a smarter chatbot hands the decision over.
why_page.closing_body: Walk through how the Concierge would carry one of your real threads forward, step by step.
